evals.prompt: Instrument a Python multi-turn RAG agent with MLflow automatic and manual tracing, OpenTelemetry export, session/user metadata, typed retriever/tool spans, PII masking, token/cost tracking, and a production sampling policy. Explain what must be version-gated.
evals.expected_output: A runnable environment-aware tracing design using current MLflow APIs, meaningful span types and context propagation, explicit privacy/sampling/async controls, OTel endpoint semantics, and version checks.

evals.prompt: Diagnose why an MLflow trace shows only a final answer for an agent that uses a retriever and tools. Show how to combine autologging with manual spans, inspect the UI/search path, preserve feedback and expectations, and avoid leaking secrets.
evals.expected_output: A trace-quality diagnosis with correct manual APIs, nested span semantics, trace-aware evaluation implications, search/UI operations, and privacy/retention safeguards.
